Nutritional Frailty Nutritional frailty is a condition that occurs in older adults and is characterized 
by low functional reserve, decreased muscle strength, and increased susceptibility to diseases. This 
is due to sarcopenia (loss of lean muscle mass), which reflects a progressive decrease in anabolism, 
increased catabolism, and a reduced muscle generation capacity. These changes lead to decreased 
overall physical functioning, increased frailty, fall risk, and eventually loss of independence. Disease
